kaggle-phishing-site-urls.name: Phishing Site URLs (Kaggle, taruntiwarihp)
kaggle-phishing-site-urls.license: See the Kaggle dataset page (not restated here).
kaggle-phishing-site-urls.notes: URLs mostly have no scheme (107 of 549,346 do). 42,151 exact-duplicate rows. Includes some non-URL garbage rows labelled 'good'. This is the dataset behind the v1.0.0 README numbers.

phiusiil.name: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL Dataset (UCI #967)
phiusiil.citation: A. Prasad and S. Chandra, "PhiUSIIL: A diverse security profile empowered phishing URL detection framework based on similarity index and incremental learning," Computers & Security, vol. 136, 2024, 103545.
phiusiil.notes: label 1 = legitimate, 0 = phishing (verified: label-0 rows include google.com/url?q=<phish> wrappers; 100% of label-1 URLs are https, so the http check alone is a dataset artifact here). Legitimate URLs are mostly bare homepages of popular sites, which overlaps with any top-sites allow-list.

emscad.name: EMSCAD — Employment Scam Aegean Dataset (Kaggle mirror: Real / Fake Job Posting Prediction)
emscad.license: See the Kaggle / EMSCAD pages (not restated here).
emscad.citation: S. Vidros, C. Kolias, G. Kambourakis, L. Akoglu, "Automatic Detection of Online Recruitment Frauds: Characteristics, Methods, and a Public Dataset," Future Internet 9(1):6, 2017.
emscad.notes: Job ADVERTISEMENTS (2012–2014), not recruiter emails/messages. 866 fraudulent / 17,014 legitimate. Converted to text,label,category by `npm run prepare:emscad`. Email-only signals (free-mail recruiter, Reply-To) cannot fire on this data.

tranco.name: Tranco top-1M list
tranco.citation: V. Le Pochat, T. Van Goethem, S. Tajalizadehkhoob, M. Korczyński, W. Joosen, "Tranco: A Research-Oriented Top Sites Ranking Hardened Against Manipulation," NDSS 2019.
